test_cases.summary:
Verify API failure
when server update fails
test_cases.description:
Feature: Label Application Workflow
Scenario: API failure
Given server update fails
When APPLY is clicked
Then a 'Failed to apply labels' toast should appear and state should revert
test_cases.acceptance:
A 'Failed to apply labels' toast should appear and state should revert
The behavior should be validated when APPLY is clicked.

test_cases.summary:
Verify Prevent apply with zero selection
when no images selected
test_cases.description:
Feature: Label Application Workflow
Scenario: Prevent apply with zero selection
Given no images selected
When APPLY is attempted
Then request should not be triggered
test_cases.acceptance:
Request should not be triggered
The behavior should be validated when APPLY is attempted.

test_cases.summary:
Verify Visual confirmation
when labels are applied
test_cases.description:
Feature: Label Application Workflow
Scenario: Visual confirmation
Given labels are applied
When grid reloads
Then updated labels should be clearly visible on each image card
test_cases.acceptance:
Updated labels should be clearly visible on each image card
The behavior should be validated when grid reloads.

test_cases.summary:
Verify Large batch labeling
when many images selected
test_cases.description:
Feature: Label Application Workflow
Scenario: Large batch labeling
Given many images selected
When labels are applied
Then operation should complete within acceptable time without UI freeze
test_cases.acceptance:
Operation should complete within acceptable time without UI freeze
The behavior should be validated when labels are applied.

test_cases.summary:
Verify Unauthorized user
when user lacks permission
test_cases.description:
Feature: Label Application Workflow
Scenario: Unauthorized user
Given user lacks permission
When attempting to apply labels
Then labeling action should be blocked
test_cases.acceptance:
Labeling action should be blocked
The behavior should be validated when attempting to apply labels.

test_cases.summary:
Verify Restore previous state
when labeling fails
test_cases.description:
Feature: Label Application Workflow
Scenario: Restore previous state
Given labeling fails
When grid refresh occurs
Then previous labels should remain unchanged
test_cases.acceptance:
Previous labels should remain unchanged
The behavior should be validated when grid refresh occurs.

test_cases.summary:
Verify pagination controls are displayed for large datasets
when the user is viewing a grid with large dataset
test_cases.description:
Feature: Pagination Controls – Visibility

Scenario: Verify pagination controls are displayed for large datasets

Given the user is viewing a grid with large dataset
When the data is loaded
Then pagination controls should be displayed including Total count, Previous, Current, and Next buttons
test_cases.acceptance:
Pagination controls should be displayed including Total count, Previous, Current, and Next buttons
The behavior should be validated when the data is loaded.

test_cases.summary:
Verify total record count is displayed
when the grid data is displayed
test_cases.description:
Feature: Pagination Controls – Total Count Display

Scenario: Verify total record count is displayed

Given the grid data is displayed
When pagination controls are visible
Then the total count should be displayed in the format “Total: [Count]”
test_cases.acceptance:
The total count should be displayed in the format "Total: [Count]"
The behavior should be validated when pagination controls are visible.

test_cases.summary:
Verify items per page dropdown options
when pagination controls are visible
test_cases.description:
Feature: Pagination Controls – Items Per Page Dropdown

Scenario: Verify items per page dropdown options

Given pagination controls are visible
When the user opens the Items per page dropdown
Then options 50, 100, and 200 should be available
test_cases.acceptance:
Options 50, 100, and 200 should be available
The behavior should be validated when the user opens the Items per page dropdown.

test_cases.summary:
Verify grid reloads when items per page is changed
when the grid is displaying data
test_cases.description:
Feature: Pagination Controls – Change Items Per Page

Scenario: Verify grid reloads when items per page is changed

Given the grid is displaying data
When the user changes items per page value
Then a new API request should be triggered with updated limit
And the grid should reload with a loading spinner
test_cases.acceptance:
A new API request should be triggered with updated limit
The behavior should be validated when the user changes items per page value.

test_cases.summary:
Verify navigation using Next button
when the user is on the current page
test_cases.description:
Feature: Pagination Controls – Next Page Navigation

Scenario: Verify navigation using Next button

Given the user is on the current page
When the user clicks the Next button
Then the system should navigate to the next page
And trigger a new API request with updated page parameter
test_cases.acceptance:
The system should navigate to the next page
The behavior should be validated when the user clicks the Next button.

test_cases.summary:
Verify navigation using Previous button
when the user is not on the first page
test_cases.description:
Feature: Pagination Controls – Previous Page Navigation

Scenario: Verify navigation using Previous button

Given the user is not on the first page
When the user clicks the Previous button
Then the system should navigate to the previous page
test_cases.acceptance:
The system should navigate to the previous page
The behavior should be validated when the user clicks the Previous button.

test_cases.summary:
Verify navigation using Goto input field
when pagination controls are visible
test_cases.description:
Feature: Pagination Controls – Goto Page Navigation

Scenario: Verify navigation using Goto input field

Given pagination controls are visible
When the user enters a valid page number in the Goto field
Then the grid should navigate to the specified page
test_cases.acceptance:
The grid should navigate to the specified page
The behavior should be validated when the user enters a valid page number in the Goto field.

test_cases.summary:
Verify system auto-corrects page number exceeding maximum pages
when the total number of pages is limited
test_cases.description:
Feature: Pagination Controls – Goto Page Upper Limit Handling

Scenario: Verify system auto-corrects page number exceeding maximum pages

Given the total number of pages is limited
When the user enters a page number greater than the maximum in the Goto field
Then the system should auto-correct to the last available page
And load the corresponding data
test_cases.acceptance:
The system should auto-correct to the last available page
The behavior should be validated when the user enters a page number greater than the maximum in the Goto field.

test_cases.summary:
Verify loading spinner is displayed during data fetch
when the user triggers pagination or page size change
test_cases.description:
Feature: Pagination Controls – Loading State

Scenario: Verify loading spinner is displayed during data fetch

Given the user triggers pagination or page size change
When a new API request is sent
Then a loading spinner should be displayed until data loads
test_cases.acceptance:
A loading spinner should be displayed until data loads
The behavior should be validated when a new API request is sent.

test_cases.summary:
Verify Valid ID returns image
when the grid contains images
test_cases.description:
Feature: Search by Image ID – exact match
Scenario: Valid ID returns image
Given the grid contains images
When the user enters a valid Image ID
Then only the matching image should be displayed
test_cases.acceptance:
Only the matching image should be displayed
The behavior should be validated when the user enters a valid Image ID.

test_cases.summary:
Verify Search field visible on load
when the grid page loads
test_cases.description:
Feature: Search Input Visibility
Scenario: Search field visible on load
Given the grid page loads
When the header renders
Then the Search Image Id input should be visible
test_cases.acceptance:
The Search Image Id input should be visible
The behavior should be validated when the header renders.

test_cases.summary:
Verify Placeholder guidance
when the input is empty
test_cases.description:
Feature: Placeholder Text
Scenario: Placeholder guidance
Given the input is empty
When displayed
Then placeholder text 'Search Image Id' should be shown
test_cases.acceptance:
Placeholder text 'Search Image Id' should be shown
The behavior should be validated when displayed.

test_cases.summary:
Verify Debounce prevents rapid calls
when the user types continuously
test_cases.description:
Feature: Debounce Query
Scenario: Debounce prevents rapid calls
Given the user types continuously
When input changes rapidly
Then API should trigger only after 300ms idle
test_cases.acceptance:
API should trigger only after 300ms idle
The behavior should be validated when input changes rapidly.

test_cases.summary:
Verify Clear resets grid
when text is entered
test_cases.description:
Feature: Clear Button
Scenario: Clear resets grid
Given text is entered
When the user clicks X
Then the grid should reset to full dataset
test_cases.acceptance:
The grid should reset to full dataset
The behavior should be validated when the user clicks X.

test_cases.summary:
Verify Unknown ID searched
when the entered ID does not exist
test_cases.description:
Feature: No Match Handling
Scenario: Unknown ID searched
Given the entered ID does not exist
When search executes
Then Empty State view should be shown
test_cases.acceptance:
Empty State view should be shown
The behavior should be validated when search executes.

test_cases.summary:
Verify Invalid characters filtered
when user enters special characters
test_cases.description:
Feature: Special Character Removal
Scenario: Invalid characters filtered
Given user enters special characters
When search triggers
Then invalid characters should be stripped automatically
test_cases.acceptance:
Invalid characters should be stripped automatically
The behavior should be validated when search triggers.

test_cases.summary:
Verify Subset filtering
when multiple IDs share prefix
test_cases.description:
Feature: Partial Search Support
Scenario: Subset filtering
Given multiple IDs share prefix
When partial text entered
Then subset of matching images should be displayed
test_cases.acceptance:
Subset of matching images should be displayed
The behavior should be validated when partial text entered.
